blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution will complete the presentation of its evidence before deciding whether to call Vice President Sara Duterte to testify in her impeachment trial, private prosecutor Benjamin “Jay” Tolosa Jr. said Saturday. Speaking at the Saturday News Forum in Quezon City, Tolosa said prosecutors will first evaluate Duterte’s declared wealth against her tax filings, official salary, business income, and bank records. He added that prosecutors also want the senator-judges to hear her explanation directly. “But again, the final decision on that will be made after we present all of our evidence,” Tolosa said.
